pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Free Plan: … unlimited recordings, call storage, and transcription… only 5 AI summaries per month. Premium Plan: $20 per user per month (billed monthly) or $16… (billed annually). Team Edition Plan: $19… or $15… Business Plan: $34… or $25"

sources.title: Fathom Pricing 2026: Free Plan or Plans from $15/mo

plans.name: Free
plans.quota: Unlimited recordings and transcription, 5 AI summaries per month

nl.tagline: Gratis AI-notulist met onbeperkt opnemen en transcriberen
nl.description: Fathom neemt je Zoom-, Meet- en Teams-gesprekken op en transcribeert ze onbeperkt, ook op het gratis plan. AI-samenvattingen zijn gratis beperkt; betaalde plannen voegen meer samenvattingen en teamfuncties toe.
bestFor: Zzp'ers en kleine teams die gratis willen starten

en.tagline: Free AI notetaker with unlimited recording and transcription
en.description: Fathom records and transcribes your Zoom, Meet and Teams calls without limits, even on the free plan. AI summaries are limited for free; paid plans add more summaries and team features.
bestFor: Freelancers and small teams starting for free
notFor: People who need many free AI summaries
